About The Role

At HelloPrint, our engineering teams are accelerating development cycles using autonomous and AI-assisted tooling. While AI makes generating code exponentially faster and cheaper, verifying that core business workflows and transaction guarantees remain intact stays just as complex. Without a rock-solid testing harness, higher code velocity simply translates to higher operational risk.

We are looking for a Senior Test Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of our automated Platform Test Harness. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain the end-to-end and contract-testing architecture that enables our teams to develop with AI fearlessly, safeguarding our core customer and commerce flows under continuous delivery.

Architect the Platform Test Harness for AI Velocity: Design, implement, and maintain deterministic E2E test suites using Playwright and TypeScript. Build the automated guardrails required to safely absorb high-frequency, AI-assisted code generation without regression.

Critical Journey Protection: 100% of primary commerce flows are guarded by automated E2E tests in CI.

Compounding Resilience: Every resolved high-priority incident has an associated regression test in the repository, making the harness the living memory of the platform.

Experience: 5+ years of software testing and automation experience as an SDET or QA Automation Engineer working with modern web applications and distributed APIs.

We are looking for QA Automation Engineer - Independent Contractor/Freelancers In Netherlands for 3 months of contract Initially

Role - QA Automation Engineer
Location - Amsterdam
Mode - Hybrid
Type - Freelancer/ Independent contractor Only
Experience - 7-15 years Max

Role Description:
- You work within a team ensuring quality is built in from inception to customer benefit realisation and throughout the entire product life cycle. You advocate delivering - customer value with minimal waste, and ensure products are usable, accessible, secure, and performant.
- Key Job Responsibilities and Duties
- Embed automation testing in the development process, where applicable
- Define and track quality metrics (test coverage, flakiness rate, MTTR, escape rate)
- Own test environment management and test data strategies
- Support the CI/CD efforts, proposes test automation tooling and infrastructure and work with developers to build and maintain it
- Actively contribute to the tech strategy by providing valuable insights on test automation and software quality in general;
- Stay up to date with new test automation technology and plan strategically for possible changes
- You will go technically deep and design and maintain automated tests across all layers: API, integration, contract, and UI
- Build evaluation frameworks - covering success rates, latency, error handling, and graceful degradation when AI-driven systems produce unexpected results
- Become the ‘Go to’ person for the test automation topic for both business and tech stakeholders-
- Working with development team to understand the business needs and identify the quality requirements
- You contribute to incident response and post-mortems with quality-focused root cause analysis
- Plan and prioritise the different strategies according to business needs
- Evaluate our internal testing tools and introduce new ones with clear migration paths and deprecation plans

Qualifications & Skills:
- 6-8 years of experience in high technological environment in a similar role
- Understanding of non-deterministic systems and ability to design test approaches that use thresholds, scoring, and statistical confidence rather than exact-match assertions
- Nice to have: experience in design and maintain test strategies for MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools and the MCP App — covering tool invocation correctness, schema validation, error handling, and end-to-end agent workflows
- Proficient in at least one of the following languages (there will be a coding challenge): Java or Javascript
- Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT) in daily development workflow - understands how these tools behave, where they break, and what "quality" means when outputs vary between runs
- An expert in unit or automation test frameworks like JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, Playwright, Postman, JMeter, REST Assured etc.
- Experience developing fully automated CI/CD pipeline, working with CI & source control tools & using Jenkins, GitHub, Gitlab, Octopus, TFS/other.
- Experience testing distributed systems at the API/service level (REST, gRPC)
- Ability to choose the right test framework in accordance with the needs of the project balancing against trade-offs
- Strong grasp of computer science fundamentals, algorithms, and data structures
- Passionate about Continuous Improvement, Innovation, New technologies
- Clear understanding of various software testing methodologies : unit, integration, smoke, performance, stress, load, regression, acceptance, usability, security etc.
- Strong knowledge of SOA/Microservices and web architecture and experience around distributed systems
- Good communication and stakeholder management skills
- Experience mentoring and training other developers on software quality topics
- Strong work ethic

Dit ga je doen

Als Senior Test Engineer zorg jij ervoor dat kwaliteit vanaf het begin onderdeel is van softwareontwikkeling. Binnen het DevOps-team ben jij de inhoudelijke specialist op het gebied van testen en kwaliteit. Je bepaalt de testaanpak, brengt risico’s vroeg in kaart en zorgt dat de juiste testen op het juiste moment worden uitgevoerd. Daarbij ontwikkel en onderhoud je geautomatiseerde API- en UI-testen met Playwright en Java.

Je versterkt DevOps-team DC, één van de twee DevOps-teams binnen Particuliere Diensten. Samen ontwikkelen en beheren jullie de applicaties achter het Particulier Portaal (Mijn DUO) en het Medewerkerportaal. Daarmee ondersteunen jullie studenten, terugbetalers en duizenden DUO-collega’s die dagelijks met deze systemen werken. Je test zowel de frontend, gebouwd met Angular en Uno Platform, als de Java REST API’s achter deze applicaties.

Als Senior Test Engineer ben je vanaf de eerste ontwerpkeuzes betrokken bij de ontwikkeling van nieuwe functionaliteiten. Je brengt risico’s in kaart, bepaalt welke testaanpak nodig is en adviseert het team over de kwaliteit van de oplossing. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor complexe testvraagstukken en zorgt ervoor dat kwaliteit niet pas aan het einde van een sprint aan bod komt.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk is testautomatisering. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt geautomatiseerde API- en UI-testen met Playwright en Java. Daarbij werk je onder andere met Cucumber en Serenity en draag je bij aan een betrouwbare CI/CD-pipeline met Jenkins. Je kijkt continu hoe testautomatisering slimmer, onderhoudbaarder en effectiever kan worden ingericht.

Binnen het team werken jullie volgens de principes van de testpiramide en streven jullie naar zoveel mogelijk geautomatiseerde testen. Samen met ontwikkelaars, ontwerpers en andere testers werk je in driewekelijkse sprints aan kwalitatieve oplossingen. Tijdens testoverleggen en peer reviews deel je jouw kennis, bespreek je verbeteringen en help je het team om verder te groeien.

Je hebt daarnaast een coachende rol. Je begeleidt minder ervaren testers, helpt ontwikkelaars bij het maken van kwaliteitsbewuste keuzes en neemt initiatief om de testaanpak binnen het team verder te ontwikkelen. Ook draag je bij aan de ontwikkeling van het testvak binnen DUO door kennis te delen en verbeteringen in gang te zetten.

Extensive knowledge of SQL.

Your mission will be to elevate system functionality, work closely with developers, and ensure robust integration testing. This role is perfect for someone eager to contribute to a high-quality, streamlined user experience.

Develop a Comprehensive QA Strategy:

Create, document, and maintain a clear QA strategy that aligns with our operational goals and product roadmap.
Promote a shift-left testing culture, ensuring quality considerations are embedded from the early stages of design and development.
Collaborate with developers and product owners to ensure the strategy is well understood and consistently applied across all teams and codebases.

Collaboration and Continuous Improvement:

Work closely with developers throughout the SDLC to provide feedback on testability, code quality, and potential edge cases.
Support the team in both maintaining existing features and ensuring high quality in the development of new features.
Manage bugs, incidents, and root cause analysis efforts, while continuously improving quality practices and testing standards.

Testing and Automation:

Design, implement, and maintain automated end-to-end and integration tests for our Laravel and React applications.
Develop and manage API test suites to validate backend functionality, performance, and reliability.
Leverage Cypress and Playwright to automate high-value test scenarios that reflect real-world user behavior.
Continuously improve and scale our test automation infrastructure to accelerate development workflows and CI/CD pipelines.

Required Skills & Qualifications

4+ years of experience as a QA Engineer or Software Tester.
Experience with Automation Testing is non negotiable. 
Strong knowledge of testing methodologies and tools
Experience with Postman API testing suite and Cypress & Playwright.
Familiarity with Javascript and PHP.
Familiarity with Github Actions and CI/CD.
Familiarity with AWS services is a plus.

The Right Mindset 

Analytical mind with great attention to detail.
Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Working location

Working hours according to Central European Time (CET)
Based in Europe or South Africa, and hired remotely unless based in the Netherlands.

Flexible hybrid work environment.
Top-notch tools and equipment provided.
Vibrant, entrepreneurial culture with opportunities for growth.
Off-sites and multi-yearly team bonding events.
Team lunches and surprise events to keep things fun.
Pension scheme. (Netherlands only).
Classpass corporate membership (Netherlands only).

Becoming part of Workwize means making an impact. We make sure that we will contribute to the change in the way of working. Description

Join the NATO IT Modernization (NITM) Programme and contribute to a high-impact international mission delivering secure, next-generation private cloud capabilities within NATO-secured environments. The Senior Test Engineer provides hands-on test engineering expertise for the verification and validation of enterprise infrastructure and cloud capabilities supporting a private cloud Software-Defined Data Center (SDDC).

The position develops, automates, executes, and documents testing across Enterprise Core Services (ECS), Client Provisioning Services (CPS), Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), DevOps, and Service Management Control (SMC). Working closely with the Test Director, Chief Engineers, Platform, Network, Firewall, Backup & Recovery, DevOps, and product engineering teams, the Senior Test Engineer validates both physical and automated implementation of integrated solutions against functional, performance, security, interoperability, and customer acceptance requirements.

The position is expected to be onsite 5 days a week at the Customer Site in The Hague, Netherlands, with frequent travel to NATO sites supporting integration, deployment, testing, and customer acceptance activities.

Primary Responsibilities

Develop, automate, execute, and document test procedures supporting private cloud SDDC modernization initiatives.
Perform functional, system integration, interoperability, regression, performance, security, resiliency, and customer acceptance testing.
Translate system, architecture, and engineering requirements into test cases, acceptance criteria, test procedures, and requirements traceability documentation.
Develop and maintain automated test capabilities using scripting, APIs, infrastructure automation, and test automation technologies.
Work with Platform, Network, Firewall, Backup & Recovery, IaaS, DevOps, and product engineering teams to validate end-to-end enterprise capabilities.
Validate physical and automated implementation of enterprise infrastructure, including compute and virtualization, networking, security, storage, backup/recovery, platform services, and associated automation workflows.
Execute testing of VMware-based private cloud infrastructure and associated SDDC technologies, validating configuration, integration, availability, performance, resiliency, and security requirements.
Validate infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) workflows to ensure automated deployments produce consistent, repeatable, and compliant configurations.
Configure and maintain representative test environments supporting system integration, technical validation, regression testing, and customer acceptance.
Identify, document, reproduce, and troubleshoot defects and integration issues, working collaboratively with engineering teams through resolution and retest.
Perform root cause investigation to help distinguish defects associated with physical infrastructure, network connectivity, platform configuration, security controls, automation, software, or integration dependencies.
Manage test cases, execution results, defects, requirements traceability, and supporting evidence using Jira and enterprise test-management tools.
Develop and maintain test plans, procedures, test cases, Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs), defect reports, test evidence, and test completion documentation.
Participate in Agile activities including backlog refinement, sprint planning, technical reviews, sprint reviews, release planning, and defect prioritization.
Support establishment and enforcement of programme testing standards, methodologies, quality gates, and engineering processes.
Analyze test results, defect trends, test coverage, and quality metrics to identify technical risks and opportunities for improvement.
Coordinate with engineering and site deployment teams to ensure test prerequisites, environments, configurations, data, access, documentation, and other dependencies are ready before formal test execution.
Travel to NATO sites to perform system integration testing, technical validation, troubleshooting, customer demonstrations, formal acceptance testing, and deployment support.
Capture test and deployment lessons learned and provide feedback to engineering teams to improve solution designs, automation, test coverage, documentation, and future implementations.
Ensure testing activities comply with NATO security policies, programme quality standards, and engineering governance requirements.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline with 8–12 years of relevant experience, or Master's degree with 6–10 years of relevant experience.
Active NATO Secret clearance (or higher).
Demonstrated hands-on experience performing test engineering or quality assurance for large-scale infrastructure, cloud, systems integration, or technology modernization programmes.
Experience performing system integration, interoperability, regression, performance, security, resiliency, and/or customer acceptance testing.
Experience testing integrated enterprise infrastructure across multiple technology domains such as compute/virtualization, networking, firewalls/security, storage, backup/recovery, cloud, and automation.
Experience developing test plans, procedures, test cases, acceptance criteria, test evidence, and requirements traceability documentation.
Experience with test automation, scripting, APIs, or automated testing frameworks.
Working knowledge of infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, PowerShell, Python, APIs, or equivalent tools.
Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, virtualization, networking, cybersecurity, backup/recovery, and system integration principles.
Experience identifying, reproducing, troubleshooting, and documenting complex infrastructure and integration defects.
Experience using Jira and test/defect-management platforms such as Xray, Zephyr, Azure DevOps Test Plans, or equivalent.
Experience working within Agile, SAFe, or DevSecOps delivery frameworks.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and cross-functional technical collaboration skills.
Experience supporting defence, government, mission-critical, or highly regulated environments.
Ability and willingness to travel internationally to NATO locations as required to support integration, deployment, testing, troubleshooting, and customer acceptance activities.

Preferred Qualifications

ISTQB or equivalent test engineering certification.
Experience supporting NATO environments and compliance frameworks.
Experience testing VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) or equivalent private cloud/SDDC infrastructure.
Experience testing VMware vSphere, vCenter, ESXi, vSAN, NSX, or associated enterprise virtualization technologies.
Familiarity with Cisco networking, Palo Alto Networks, enterprise storage, backup/recovery, and associated data-center technologies.
Hands-on experience with infrastructure automation technologies including Ansible, Terraform, PowerShell, Python, APIs, or equivalent tools.
Experience with automated testing frameworks, API testing, infrastructure testing, performance testing, security testing, and resiliency testing tools.
Experience developing Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs), verification cross-reference matrices, and formal test evidence supporting customer acceptance.
Familiarity with continuous testing, CI/CD pipelines, and automated quality gates.
Experience supporting formal customer site acceptance, infrastructure commissioning, and technical validation activities.
Experience supporting large-scale, geographically distributed infrastructure modernization and enterprise systems integration programmes.
Experience improving test methodologies and automation based on lessons learned from integration and site deployment activities.

Leadership and Strategy
Design and own the QA strategy across the NedGraphics and Optitex product portfolios, bringing a clear point of view on what good looks like based on prior experience building QA functions elsewhere

Build a quality-focused culture within the team and across the wider engineering organisation

Set a clear direction for the team and develop individuals to reach their potential

Automation and Tooling
Expand automation coverage significantly across the product suite
Set the automation roadmap and direct the existing automation engineer
Identify and introduce AI-assisted testing tools to improve speed and coverage
Progressively reduce reliance on manual regression testing

Stay close to the product portfolio to provide well-informed quality judgment
Set the standard for how good testing is done

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Essential
Proven experience leading or managing a QA team, ideally having built or significantly transformed a QA function from the ground up

Strong communication skills with the ability to influence engineers, PMs, and senior stakeholders
A track record of improving QA processes and delivering measurable results

Prior experience leading a team, with a clear approach to setting direction, delegating, and developing people
Desirable
Experience with AI-assisted testing tools or a genuine interest in adopting them
Background in software product companies, ideally with desktop application portfolios
Exposure to agile or scrum delivery environments
Experience growing an automation capability from the ground up
Familiarity with Azure DevOps for work item tracking, test plans, and pipeline integration

A new, senior role with real scope to shape how quality is done at NedGraphics
Close collaboration with VP Engineering and a technically strong R&D team
A team of 5 QA engineers to lead and develop
Competitive salary plus 5% discretionary bonus
Flexible working arrangements across EU/UK

Job Description:
Description

Join the NATO IT Modernization (NITM) Programme and contribute to a high-impact international mission delivering secure, next-generation private cloud capabilities within NATO-secured environments. The Senior Test Engineer provides hands-on test engineering expertise for the verification and validation of enterprise infrastructure and cloud capabilities supporting a private cloud Software-Defined Data Center (SDDC).

The position develops, automates, executes, and documents testing across Enterprise Core Services (ECS), Client Provisioning Services (CPS), Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), DevOps, and Service Management Control (SMC). Working closely with the Test Director, Chief Engineers, Platform, Network, Firewall, Backup & Recovery, DevOps, and product engineering teams, the Senior Test Engineer validates both physical and automated implementation of integrated solutions against functional, performance, security, interoperability, and customer acceptance requirements.

The position is expected to be onsite 5 days a week at the Customer Site in The Hague, Netherlands, with frequent travel to NATO sites supporting integration, deployment, testing, and customer acceptance activities.

Primary Responsibilities

Develop, automate, execute, and document test procedures supporting private cloud SDDC modernization initiatives.
Perform functional, system integration, interoperability, regression, performance, security, resiliency, and customer acceptance testing.
Translate system, architecture, and engineering requirements into test cases, acceptance criteria, test procedures, and requirements traceability documentation.
Develop and maintain automated test capabilities using scripting, APIs, infrastructure automation, and test automation technologies.
Work with Platform, Network, Firewall, Backup & Recovery, IaaS, DevOps, and product engineering teams to validate end-to-end enterprise capabilities.
Validate physical and automated implementation of enterprise infrastructure, including compute and virtualization, networking, security, storage, backup/recovery, platform services, and associated automation workflows.
Execute testing of VMware-based private cloud infrastructure and associated SDDC technologies, validating configuration, integration, availability, performance, resiliency, and security requirements.
Validate infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) workflows to ensure automated deployments produce consistent, repeatable, and compliant configurations.
Configure and maintain representative test environments supporting system integration, technical validation, regression testing, and customer acceptance.
Identify, document, reproduce, and troubleshoot defects and integration issues, working collaboratively with engineering teams through resolution and retest.
Perform root cause investigation to help distinguish defects associated with physical infrastructure, network connectivity, platform configuration, security controls, automation, software, or integration dependencies.
Manage test cases, execution results, defects, requirements traceability, and supporting evidence using Jira and enterprise test-management tools.
Develop and maintain test plans, procedures, test cases, Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs), defect reports, test evidence, and test completion documentation.
Participate in Agile activities including backlog refinement, sprint planning, technical reviews, sprint reviews, release planning, and defect prioritization.
Support establishment and enforcement of programme testing standards, methodologies, quality gates, and engineering processes.
Analyze test results, defect trends, test coverage, and quality metrics to identify technical risks and opportunities for improvement.
Coordinate with engineering and site deployment teams to ensure test prerequisites, environments, configurations, data, access, documentation, and other dependencies are ready before formal test execution.
Travel to NATO sites to perform system integration testing, technical validation, troubleshooting, customer demonstrations, formal acceptance testing, and deployment support.
Capture test and deployment lessons learned and provide feedback to engineering teams to improve solution designs, automation, test coverage, documentation, and future implementations.
Ensure testing activities comply with NATO security policies, programme quality standards, and engineering governance requirements.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline with 8–12 years of relevant experience, or Master's degree with 6–10 years of relevant experience.
Active NATO Secret clearance (or higher).
Demonstrated hands-on experience performing test engineering or quality assurance for large-scale infrastructure, cloud, systems integration, or technology modernization programmes.
Experience performing system integration, interoperability, regression, performance, security, resiliency, and/or customer acceptance testing.
Experience testing integrated enterprise infrastructure across multiple technology domains such as compute/virtualization, networking, firewalls/security, storage, backup/recovery, cloud, and automation.
Experience developing test plans, procedures, test cases, acceptance criteria, test evidence, and requirements traceability documentation.
Experience with test automation, scripting, APIs, or automated testing frameworks.
Working knowledge of infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, PowerShell, Python, APIs, or equivalent tools.
Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, virtualization, networking, cybersecurity, backup/recovery, and system integration principles.
Experience identifying, reproducing, troubleshooting, and documenting complex infrastructure and integration defects.
Experience using Jira and test/defect-management platforms such as Xray, Zephyr, Azure DevOps Test Plans, or equivalent.
Experience working within Agile, SAFe, or DevSecOps delivery frameworks.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and cross-functional technical collaboration skills.
Experience supporting defence, government, mission-critical, or highly regulated environments.
Ability and willingness to travel internationally to NATO locations as required to support integration, deployment, testing, troubleshooting, and customer acceptance activities.

Preferred Qualifications

ISTQB or equivalent test engineering certification.
Experience supporting NATO environments and compliance frameworks.
Experience testing VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) or equivalent private cloud/SDDC infrastructure.
Experience testing VMware vSphere, vCenter, ESXi, vSAN, NSX, or associated enterprise virtualization technologies.
Familiarity with Cisco networking, Palo Alto Networks, enterprise storage, backup/recovery, and associated data-center technologies.
Hands-on experience with infrastructure automation technologies including Ansible, Terraform, PowerShell, Python, APIs, or equivalent tools.
Experience with automated testing frameworks, API testing, infrastructure testing, performance testing, security testing, and resiliency testing tools.
Experience developing Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs), verification cross-reference matrices, and formal test evidence supporting customer acceptance.
Familiarity with continuous testing, CI/CD pipelines, and automated quality gates.
Experience supporting formal customer site acceptance, infrastructure commissioning, and technical validation activities.
Experience supporting large-scale, geographically distributed infrastructure modernization and enterprise systems integration programmes.
Experience improving test methodologies and automation based on lessons learned from integration and site deployment activities.
